name: What is the process for starting an aging-in-place remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting an aging-in-place remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your needs, budget, and desired outcomes. Next, a detailed assessment of your current home is conducted to identify areas for improvement and propose specific modifications. After design and material selections are finalized, a detailed proposal and timeline are provided. Upon agreement, permits are secured if necessary, and construction begins, followed by final inspection and walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: Starting an aging-in-place remodel involves consultation, home assessment, design, proposal, permit acquisition, construction, and final inspection.
